text:
## Record Retention  
**AML Records Retained:**
- Customer verification documents (5 years post-closure minimum)
- SAR files (5 years)
- Transaction records related to SAR (5 years)
- Risk assessments (5 years)
- Screening results (5 years)  
**Storage:** Secure document management system (DMS)
**Access Control:** Compliance staff only
**Audit Trail:** All access logged

raw_entities.name: Record Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the retention and storage of AML-related records including customer verification documents, SAR files, transaction records, risk assessments, and screening results. Specifies minimum retention periods of 5 years post-closure and mandates secure storage with access controls limited to compliance staff.
context: AML Records Retained: Customer verification documents (5 years post-closure minimum), SAR files (5 years), Transaction records related to SAR (5 years), Risk assessments (5 years), Screening results (5 years)

raw_entities.name: Customer Verification Document Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain customer verification documents for a minimum of 5 years following account closure. Documents must be stored in a secure document management system with access restricted to compliance staff.
context: Customer verification documents (5 years post-closure minimum)

raw_entities.name: SAR File Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain all SAR files for a minimum of 5 years. Records must be maintained in a secure document management system with audit trail logging of all access.

raw_entities.name: SAR-Related Transaction Record Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain transaction records related to SARs for a minimum of 5 years. Records must be stored securely with access limited to compliance staff and all access events logged.
context: Transaction records related to SAR (5 years)

raw_entities.name: Risk Assessment Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain risk assessments for a minimum of 5 years. Records must be maintained in a secure document management system with restricted access and audit logging.

raw_entities.name: Screening Results Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to retain screening results for a minimum of 5 years. Records must be stored in a secure document management system with access controls and comprehensive audit trail logging.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff Access Control for Retained Records
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement restricting access to all retained AML records to compliance staff only. Access must be logged and audited to maintain record integrity and regulatory compliance.

raw_entities.name: Audit Trail Logging for Record Access
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to log all access to retained AML records in an audit trail. This requirement applies to all records stored in the secure document management system.

raw_entities.name: Secure Document Management System
raw_entities.description: Secure document management system used to store all retained AML records including customer verification documents, SAR files, transaction records, risk assessments, and screening results. System enforces access controls and maintains audit trails of all access events.

raw_entities.name: Access Control Restriction to Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Access control mechanism that restricts retrieval and viewing of retained AML records to compliance staff only. Prevents unauthorized access to sensitive compliance documentation.

raw_entities.name: Access Audit Trail Logging
raw_entities.description: Audit logging mechanism that records all access events to retained AML records in the document management system. Enables monitoring and investigation of record access for compliance and security purposes.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Staff members with designated responsibility for accessing, managing, and maintaining retained AML records. Only compliance staff are authorized to access records stored in the secure document management system.

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering Risk
raw_entities.description: Money laundering risk that the record retention policy is designed to mitigate through comprehensive documentation and audit trail controls. The policy ensures that evidence of customer verification, suspicious activity reporting, and transaction monitoring is preserved for regulatory examination.
context: AML Records Retained: Customer verification documents (5 years post-closure minimum), SAR files (5 years), Transaction records related to SAR (5 years), Risk assessments (5 years), Screening results (5 years)

raw_entities.description: Official identity and verification documents collected during customer onboarding and KYC processes. Policy requires retention for a minimum of 5 years following account closure in a secure document management system.
context: Customer verification documents (5 years post-closure minimum)

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report File
raw_entities.description: Internal SAR documentation and filing records that must be retained for a minimum of 5 years. Records are stored in a secure document management system with access restricted to compliance staff and comprehensive audit logging.
